note: Weights of the Axiom Score's measures (any non-negative number; 0 leaves a measure out). Set by the strategy lab: B_joint3 (round 6, 2026-11-20) ranked coins that went on to climb 30%+ before falling 15% better than the first hand-set weights on its own test coins (0.79 vs 0.40) and again on 59 coins it never saw (round 8: 0.74 vs 0.51). It ranks which coins climb; it is not a timing signal.
